run_acp_agent_server: run the hermes-agent ACP adapter server via the main entry point
setup_logging_to_stderr: setup logging to route all output to stderr so stdout stays clean for ACP JSON-RPC transport
load_hermes_env_file: load environment variables from ~/.hermes/.env for the hermes-agent configuration
filter_benign_probe_logs: filter out benign probe method tracebacks (ping, health, healthcheck) from ACP background task logs
create_hermes_acp_agent: create a HermesACPAgent instance and run it with the ACP protocol over stdio
